faq.q: I'm not technical. Can I still do this?
faq.a: Yes — that's the whole point. You don't need to code. I hand you shortcuts in plain English that just work.

faq.q: Do I have to replace the tools I already use?
faq.a: No. We work with your CRM, your email, your calendar. I never make you switch just to switch.

faq.q: What if the free guides aren't enough?
faq.a: That's what the build sprint and workshops are for. Start free, go further when you're ready — never before.

faq.q: How fast will I see results?
faq.a: Some wins land the same week: one task automated, one hour back. A full system takes a few weeks. Real change, not a hack.

what_you_get.title: The right task, picked properly

what_you_get.body: I build it while you watch and ask questions. No black box. You see every decision, because you're the one who lives with it.

what_you_get.body: One page: what it does, what it never does, and what good looks like. The part that makes it reliable — and the part everyone skips.

what_you_get.body: Your logins, your accounts, your tools. When we finish, you own it. No retainer, no keys held back.

what_you_get.body: What it can touch, what it must never send, and how to decide what data goes near it — written down so it survives a busy week.

what_you_get.body: The real questions surface in the first fortnight. That's when a build sticks instead of quietly getting abandoned. You can ask them.

ecommerce.built: A support bot that instantly answers the common questions, gives live order status, and hands anything complex to a person. It runs on the website and the store's messaging apps, so customers get an answer the moment they ask.
